images.screen: A · 교정지 (3회차, 문장에 붉은 교정 부호를 얹는 순간)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down view of a night-time editor's walnut desk lit by a warm tungsten lamp from the upper right, deep vignette. Left two thirds: a cream Korean manuscript sheet (200-cell wongoji paper, pale blue printed grid, black serif characters one per cell), slightly rotated, with a paperclip and one faint coffee ring. The core mechanic is visible: hand-drawn red proofreading marks layered on the text — a strikethrough with pigtail, bracket cuts, an insertion caret with handwritten words above, a wavy underline linked to a circled question mark in the margin, a looping praise circle — older rounds in faded brick red, the current round in fresh vivid red, one refused mark left as a dashed line with a pencil reply. One sentence is softly highlighted as selected. Right side as physical props: the author's handwritten reply letter on ruled paper with a stamp, an index card with hatched meters, a dark green felt tray of seven paper chits each showing a red mark glyph, an effect preview card and a kraft envelope button. Muted cream, walnut brown, printer blue, graded reds. Korean UI text: "붉은 펜", "3회차", "물음표 주석", "봉투에 넣기". Text constraints: the author's reply letter is signed "— 소하"; no other personal names appear.

images.screen: B · 마지막 봉투 (5회차 결말 — 청하지 않은 문장)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Early dawn on the same desk: the lamp is off, cool blue window light falls in diagonal venetian-blind stripes, dust motes drift. The manuscript sheet lies tilted on an opened kraft envelope, now dense with five rounds of red proofreading marks whose ink grades from faded rust to fresh crimson, showing the history of the relationship. Over it rests a small torn slip of ruled notepaper held by a brass paperclip, filled with the author's own blue-black handwriting — an unrequested new sentence — glowing faintly, untouched by any red. A capped red felt pen lies diagonally beside it. Right side: a large elegant serif ending title, four threshold readouts with red hand-drawn check marks, and a row of five miniature manuscript thumbnails that grow redder round by round. Quiet, emotional, tactile paper textures, soft shadows, film grain. Korean text: "청하지 않은 문장", "다섯 번 오간 붉은 자국", "— 소하". Text constraints: the manuscript is the same 200-cell wongoji sheet as round 3, one character per cell, carrying readable Korean sentences from the same story (e.g. "가을이 오면, 나는 늘 이 거리를 걷는다." "때로는 넘어지며, 다시 일어난다."); no nonsense syllables; red marks overlay these real sentences.
